head: Fold & Squish recreates the folded butterfly painting from school
dek: In Fold & Squish you paint on half a page, fold it, rub it and peel it open to a mirror-image print; the paint is thick, wet and mixes. It was #18 among paid Entertainment apps on the US App Store on 5 November.
details: It costs $1.99 with in-app purchases, by Fountain Interactive.
means: If you remember butterfly paintings from school, this is that, without the mess.
todo: Find Fold & Squish in the App Store.
